Meaning: A master inventory to trim, not a recommendation to run everything. Categories organize actual datasets/protocols; rows may share source records.
Task / actual dataset; Task evaluation targets (including sizes); Example Questions; Reported results.
Published paper/repository values, never our runs. Selected models and settings are identified; no cross-metric category average is invented.
Copied from the source-linked 14 October workbook or original catalog. Not independently re-audited in this expansion.
Newly inspected paper or official repository. This verifies reported content, not downloaded payloads or reproduced performance.
The exact count, retained split, scorer, or result is not established here. This does not mean zero performance or an invalid scientific task.
Test proteins, variants, complexes, questions, assays, generated candidates and corpus totals are distinct. Do not add unlike units.
100 generated samples for one target is not 100 independent test targets. The verifier and compute budget are part of the setting.
The same dataset name can have different retained sets: RAbD 60 versus ProteinBench 55; PFMBench resplits differ from PEER/TAPE.
Reference outcomes come from existing laboratory measurements. New generated candidates still require their own validation.
Reference labels are curated or inferred annotations. Unannotated does not necessarily mean the biological activity is absent.
Targets are calculated from coordinates or reference structures. Legitimate when splits/scorers are defined; not equivalent to measured function.
Scores come from learned predictors, MD, docking or structural self-consistency. Identify the evaluator; do not report as a new experiment.
Text overlap, model judgments and expert preferences measure different aspects of an explanation. Outcome correctness does not verify every mechanism.
Raw sequence-as-text can form a baseline, but that is not equivalent to an encoder-plus-head protocol or proof the task is purely reasoning.
Keep required images, coordinates, expression features, assay objectives and candidate context. Text transcription defines a new variant.
Remove only optional explanations. Retain the question, sequences, objective and every task-defining field.
Only protocol-permitted context. Keep the source and timing explicit; no held-out outcomes or gold explanation leakage.
A supervised specialist, a prompted API model and a tool-enabled agent do not have identical information or adaptation budgets.
All example questions here are illustrative paraphrases of task definitions, not recovered benchmark examples or new labeled data.
Undecided / Keep / Defer / Drop is for your planning. Editing it does not itself start agent work or remove underlying records.
All 64 original IDs are mapped in a separate sheet. Original 14-setting initial scope and benchmark restrictions remain unchanged.
RAbD/SAbDab are ordinary design protocols. The PDB structural questions remain an internal-diagnostics appendix until the held-out set is clarified.
Catalog, source URLs, metadata, legends, prior ID mapping, and agent-update instructions. No raw benchmark payloads, weights, executable harness, or model predictions.
Broad coverage of the discussed biological/protein domains, with adjacent modalities retained. It is not a claim to enumerate every benchmark in biology.
